titles.title: Roleplay Me Out of This Curse

description:
As the eldest daughter of a struggling noble house, Erika must get engaged to an unsavory marquess to save her family from financial ruin. Unfortunately, she and her childhood friend, Ares, get cursed by a forbidden book and are forced to act out the raunchy stories in it! 

But the more they roleplay against the clock to lift the curse before Erika's engagement ceremony, the less Erika wants her intimate time with Ares to end. 

Will the book's final episode be their last, or is the next chapter in their story waiting to be written?
